assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original portrait 2:3 editorial artwork for a literary writing services homepage genre shelf.
Primary request: an atmospheric winding path through a lush forest leading toward a softly illuminated distant village, evoking fiction, mystery and narrative possibility through meaningful literary imagery.
Style/medium: beautifully detailed painterly editorial cover art, tactile fine-art gouache and oil texture on paper, sophisticated and handcrafted.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, full bleed artwork, immersive forest foreground and winding path visually leading to the small distant village, clear readable subject at thumbnail size. Art itself, NOT a book mockup.
Lighting/mood: warmly lit village against atmospheric forest shade, quiet wonder.
Color palette: cohesive warm brown, cream and ochre with restrained deep green and navy accents.
Constraints: absolutely no text, no letters, no branding, no author names, no titles, no typography, no watermark, no border, no fake book cover product, no random abstract shapes.
assets.qa: Passed: portrait full bleed forest path to village; no visible typography or marks.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original portrait 2:3 editorial illustration for a nonfiction writing services genre card.
Primary request: beautifully composed conceptual still life of an open blank book, ascending limestone architectural steps and a single smooth brass ring with a perfectly plain polished surface, alongside a flourishing botanical branch. The simple circle is symbolic of orientation and knowledge; it is NOT a compass, not a clock and not a dial. The whole artwork represents learning and practical knowledge.
Style/medium: tactile sophisticated fine-art oil and gouache painting with softly visible brushwork and paper grain. Warm brown, cream and ochre with restrained deep green and navy accents. Quiet soft sunlight and warm shadows. Portrait 2:3 full bleed, tightly framed architectural still life with clear subject at thumbnail size, no book mockup.
Mandatory constraints: every surface completely unmarked; blank pages; plain brass ring with no face or markings; absolutely NO text, letters, symbols, numerals, tick marks, scales, inscriptions, lettering, logos, signatures, titles, author names, branding or watermark. No maps, no charts, no labels, no pseudo-writing. Only book, steps, plain brass ring and botanical growth.
assets.qa: Passed: open blank book, stone steps, brass ring and botanical growth with no markings. One retry corrected unwanted compass markings.

assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original portrait 2:3 editorial artwork for a memoir and autobiography writing services homepage genre shelf.
Primary request: intimate painterly still life of an open personal journal, a small group of old family photographs turned partly away, and a sunlit window with a small leafy branch, evoking memory and legacy. No identifiable real people. The photographs are seen from their cream-colored backs, or obliquely enough that figures are only tiny indistinct silhouettes.
Style/medium: beautifully detailed painterly editorial cover art, tactile fine-art gouache and oil texture on paper, sophisticated handcrafted feel, quietly moving, no book mockup.
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3 full bleed artwork, tightly composed open journal and old photos on a warm wooden desk beneath the window, no actual book cover design, clear at thumbnail size.
Lighting/mood: tender and reflective, warm sunlight coming through window, soft shadows.
Color palette: cohesive warm brown, cream and ochre with restrained deep green and navy accents.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, branding, author names, titles, typography, signatures, watermarks or readable handwriting. Pages may have extremely faint abstract graphite impressions suggesting past writing, with no letter forms or legible marks. No text on photo backs. No identifiable faces.
assets.qa: Passed: journal with indistinct abstract pencil strokes, old photos with unidentifiable silhouettes, warm sunlit window and botanical branch; no legible writing.
